Config Functions

  • phpcore_ini_get - Gets the value of a configuration option

  • phpcore_ini_get_all - Gets all configuration options

  • phpcore_ini_restore - Restores the value of a configuration option

  • phpcore_ini_set - Sets the value of a configuration option

Many of the config functions below are just aliases for the methods of the PHPCore Config Class.

See also

PHPCore Config Class

The PHPCore config class.

phpcore_ini_get(string $option)

Gets the value of a configuration option

Returns the value of the configuration option on success.

Parameters

  • $option (string) – The configuration option name.

Returns

mixed Returns the value of the configuration option on success. Returns null if the configuration option doesn’t exist.

Back to list

phpcore_ini_get_all(?string $extension = null, ?bool $details = true)

Gets all configuration options

Returns all the registered configuration options.

Parameters

  • $extension (?string) – An optional extension name. If not null the function returns only options specific for that extension.

  • $details (?bool) – Retrieve details settings or only the current value for each setting. Default is true (retrieve details).

Returns

?array Returns an associative array with directive name as the array key. Returns null if the extension doesn’t exist.

Back to list

phpcore_ini_restore(string $option)

Restores the value of a configuration option

Restores a given configuration option to its original value.

Parameters

  • $option (string) – The configuration option name.

Returns

void

Back to list

phpcore_ini_set(string $option, mixed $value)

Sets the value of a configuration option

Sets the value of the given configuration option. The configuration option will keep this new value during the script’s execution, and will be restored at the script’s ending.

Parameters

  • $option (string) – The configuration option name to set.

  • $value (mixed) – The new value for the option.

Returns

mixed Returns the old value on success, null on failure.

Back to list
